title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for h(t) must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Heat Transfer Equation
description: Important Criteria: The relationship between heat loss and ice formation must be correctly established.

title: Variable Definitions
description: Important Criteria: All variables such as h, L/V, and Lambda should be clearly defined.

title: Differential Equation Setup
description: Important Criteria: The differential equation relating h and time must be correctly formulated.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units for all quantities should be consistent throughout the solution.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for sign mistakes or incorrect assumptions about heat transfer.

title: Neglecting Specific Heat
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that the assumption of neglecting specific heat is justified.
